extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null and recurring capex is not applicable. Figures from the three-month 2023 column of the reconciliation on seq 11 (printed page 7); seq 17 (S-3) repeats the same figures. Zero-value rows (dashes) omitted: gains on sale of real estate and land, casualty loss, loss on early retirement of debt from unconsolidated co-investment, co-investment promote income. Diluted shares 66,444,114 converted to thousands (66,444.114). Check: 99,620 + 136,718 + 17,848 + 3,506 - 365 = 257,327; core bridge sums to 250,493; 257,327/66,444.114 = $3.87 and 250,493/66,444.114 = $3.77, matching reported. Categories for deferred tax, provision for credit losses, equity income from non-core co-investments, preferred equity redemption income and G&A were set to 'other'; the insurance/legal/other line was set to 'legal' per its label.
